4:163.text: Verily, We have sent the revelation to you
as We sent the revelation to Nûh
and the Prophets after him; We
[the offspring of the twelve sons of Ya‘qûb (Jacob)]

4:164.text: And Messengers We have mentioned to you before, and Messengers We have not mentioned to you, - and to Mûsâ

4:165.text: Messengers as bearers of good news as well as of warning in order that mankind should have no plea against Allâh after the
Messengers. And Allâh is Ever All-Powerful, All-Wise.

4:166.text: But Allâh bears witness to that which He has sent down
; He has sent it down with His Knowledge, and the angels bear witness. And Allâh is All-Sufficient as a Witness.

4:167.text: [by concealing the truth about Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his message of true Islâmic Monotheism written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel) with them]
; they have certainly strayed far away.

4:168.text: Verily, those who disbelieve and did wrong
[by concealing the truth about Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his message of true Islâmic Monotheism written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel) with them]
; Allâh will not forgive them, nor will He guide them to any way -

4:169.text: Except the way of Hell, to dwell therein forever; and this is ever easy for Allâh.

4:170.text: O mankind! Verily, there has come to you the Messenger

with the truth from your Lord. So believe in him, it is better for you. But if you disbelieve, then certainly to Allâh belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth. And Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.
